text: おまえ　まだ　たんパン　はいて　ないじゃん

structure.jp: まだ　たんパン　はいて　ないじゃん
structure.en: still aren't wearing shorts, are you!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て form plus いる says a state is going on; here it is in the 'not' form and the い is dropped, as in casual speech. はいて　ない = 'are not wearing'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃん is a casual short form of じゃないか, used to point something out with a bit of surprise. はいて　ないじゃん = 'hey, you're not wearing them!'
